recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s album cover aesthetic featuring a female subject in a patterned mod dress, partially obscured by dramatic, diagonal orange and yellow light streaks. The composition utilizes a dark, textured background with bold, tightly-spaced sans-serif typography anchored in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject is framed and partially bisected by glowing light beams.
The bright yellow and white text contrasts sharply against the dark void of the background.
The diagonal movement of the light streaks opposes the vertical stance of the subject.
coreInvariants: Heavy grain and analog film texture
Diagonal light leak effect with soft edges
Tight, overlapping letter spacing in the display text
High-contrast color palette of black, orange, and yellow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length female figure positioned slightly right of center, scaled to occupy approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow display text in the top right corner acts as the primary focal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright text, follow the vertical line of the subject down, and are swept back up by the diagonal light beams.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of dark, textured black space on the left and right edges provide breathing room for the light effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background with heavy film grain.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and amber for the light leak effects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright lemon yellow and stark white for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light beams against zero saturation in the background; high value contrast in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm tones and monochrome

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a tight, circular loop
Capital 'L' and 'C' with minimal horizontal extension

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the dark background and edges of the light beams

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Helvetica Bold or Neue Haas Grotesk
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century Swiss style and tight kerning capability.
Provides the necessary weight and vintage editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a woman in a 1960s yellow patterned mini-dress standing against a black background. Apply heavy diagonal orange and yellow light leak effects that partially obscure her body. Add heavy analog film grain and dust textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned bold sans-serif text in the top right corner. Use white for the top line and yellow for the following lines. Set tracking to negative so letters almost touch. Add a list of smaller white text below the main title.

verificationChecks: Are the light leaks diagonal and warm-toned?
Is the grain visible and consistent?
Is the tracking on the display text tight enough?

adjustableVariables: Color of the display text (yellow vs white)
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'touching' letters in the display text.
Ensure the light beams have a soft, glowing edge.
Verify the background is a textured black, not a flat color.
Confirm the subject's attire matches the mid-century mod style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject in Mod Fashion] + [Diagonal Light Leaks] + [Right-Aligned Tight Sans-Serif Typography] + [Heavy Film Grain].
